title: Choose the right capability for an engineering task

sources.basis: Draft black-box stakeholder situation for IR-009 common Skills-product behavior. The Scenario awaits independent semantic review and does not claim detailed specialist clause migration or runtime evidence.

Draft black-box stakeholder situation for IR-009 common Skills-product behavior. The Scenario awaits independent semantic review and does not claim detailed specialist clause migration or runtime evidence.

Independent review and author reconciliation confirmed this stakeholder situation, primary Feature, and SR coverage as current analysis knowledge. This does not approve requirements or establish implemented behavior or satisfaction.

actor: An engineer planning a bounded task
goal: Identify a supported capability whose scope matches the intended engineering outcome.
context: Several published capabilities have neighboring purposes, and the engineer has not yet invoked one.
trigger: The engineer needs help investigating a proposed change.

interaction.action: Describes the intended outcome and available project context.
Presents applicable capabilities, their purposes, triggers, relevant near misses, and behavioral owners.
Selects the capability matching the task or supplies the missing distinction.

expected_outcome: The engineer can choose an appropriate supported capability and understand what its invocation covers.

alternatives.condition: The engineer already knows the public capability name.
alternatives.outcome: The system explains its applicability and relevant exclusions before detailed work.

failures.condition: The request is too ambiguous or outside the supported inventory.
failures.outcome: The system identifies the missing distinction or unsupported scope without beginning an unrelated activity.
